text:
OTT arrives off a 7-4 win over NYR three days ago, when Drake Batherson scored three goals, and sits 3-2-0 in its last five. The Senators are without Thomas Chabot and William Eklund, and Samuel Ersson (projected) starts with Linus Ullmark on injured reserve. VGK is winless in three (0-2-1) after losing 2-1 in overtime at CBJ, though the chances say that run is mostly bad luck: it had 55% of the expected goals, a measure of shot quality, over those games. Mitch Marner could be back after ESPN cleared him from its injury report.

Our numbers lean slightly to the home side, 3.11 expected goals to 2.89. VGK creates more (3.42 expected goals per 60 minutes, against 3.13) and allows fewer (2.64 to 2.92). Special teams may matter: OTT takes 4.9 penalties a game, and VGK's penalty kill allows just 0.34 expected goals per game. In net, Ersson is at -4.4 goals saved above expected this season, which compares a goalie's results to the shots he faced, and Carter Hart (projected) is at -0.7. Last season they were at -17.8 and -4.4.

Tim Stützle has a 72% chance at a point and 33% to score, riding a four-game point streak. Batherson is at 31% to score. For VGK, Jack Eichel has a 74% chance at a point, and Mark Stone, a former Senator, is at 35% to score. Nic Dowd is one point from 200 career points.
